findings_requiring_reconciliation: Material modification of production user records is not separately or clearly represented in the current source-clause inventory.
Separate four evaluation runs from the occurrence-level chain; the public source does not disclose complete per-run ordering.
Distinguish perception that target is real from mistaken claim of authority. Do not infer concealment, independent goals or coordination; provider expressly disclaims those in these incidents.
